capabilities: create tabbed blocks in notes with marker or fenced syntax
edit tab bodies with keyboard navigation, renaming, and per-tab add/delete
nest layouts and include embeds, queries, callouts, math, and Mermaid in tab bodies
configure position, density, palette, and icons via context menus or config comments
set global appearance defaults through Style Settings
extras: Publishing tabs on a Quartz site uses a separate publishing plugin; the plugin runs locally with no network requests, telemetry, or account, and can be installed via BRAT or manually copied into the plugins folder.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to hide content behind tabs inside a note, so authors cannot present alternative text, examples, or sections in a tabbed layout.

relations.evidence: Templater recipes — Generate tab layouts from static or prompted templates.
Quartz publishing — Render tabs on a Quartz site with the separate publishing plugin.

summary: Markdown plugin that renders accessible, theme-native tabbed content blocks in Reading View and Live Preview on desktop and mobile.
